data.answer: Yes. In Australia, pharmaceutical substances that experience a delay in market approval can receive a patent term extension, providing up to **25 years of protection**, rather than the usual maximum of 20 years.[1]

citations.quote: The maximum term of a patent is 20 years, though pharmaceutical substances that experience a delay in market approval can receive an extension, providing up to 25 years of protection.

claims.text: In Australia, pharmaceutical substances that experience a delay in market approval can receive a patent term extension, providing up to 25 years of protection rather than the usual maximum of 20 years.
